logp.method_description: The lipophilicities of 1 and 2 have been determined by the “shake-flask” method using octanol/water phase partitions. Octanol-saturated water and water-saturated octanol were prepared using analytical-grade octanol and double-distilled water. The complexes under study (1 mg mL–1; 1:6 ethanol/water) were diluted to 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 μg mL–1 in water; subsequently, these (1 mg mL–1) were diluted to 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 μg mL–1 in octanol. Appropriate amounts of the complexes (4 mg mL–1) were shaken for 24 h at room temperature in equal volume (50:50). After equilibrium, the organic and aqueous phases were separated and centrifuged. Finally, the concentration of the drug in each phase was determined by UV/vis spectroscopy. The sample solution concentration was used to calculate log P and the partition coefficients for 1 and 2 using the equation log P = log [complex]octanol/[complex]water
